text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours while the Fear & Greed Index sits in greed territory with a strong 7-day climb, suggesting conviction among buyers despite small pullbacks. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 59% alongside $100B in daily volume indicates steady capital flow rather than panic or euphoria. Altcoins are underperforming more sharply than the majors, a typical pattern when risk appetite cools slightly even as overall sentiment remains constructive.
